description: This file contains logging and utility functions for WebSocket request/response logging within the gateway component, including message formatting, log level control, and in-flight request tracking.

methods.name: shouldLogWs
methods.description: Checks if WebSocket logging is enabled for the gateway subsystem.

methods.name: shortId
methods.description: Generates a shortened identifier for UUIDs or long strings for logging.

methods.name: formatForLog
methods.description: Formats various types of values into log-friendly strings, with redaction for sensitive info.

methods.name: logWs
methods.description: Logs WebSocket message details, handling different styles and verbosity levels.
